text:
You need a mobile-first MVP website that feels modern, responsive, and easy to use on phones, and I can build that for you.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. For projects like yours, I focus on clean implementation, fast interactions, and a layout that translates well from Figma to production without losing the intended mobile experience.

A recent example was a **Streaming chat widget** for Quillstack, where I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. The result was a first token on screen in about **600 ms**. I also built a **Live fleet dashboard** for Ferrylane Freight, creating a dispatcher map that showed every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived, with **1,800 trucks tracked live** and updates reaching the screen in **under 2 seconds**.

For your MVP, I can take the Figma design and turn it into a polished responsive website with a strong mobile layout, smooth UI behavior, and clean component structure. I’m comfortable building with React and can work with the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript foundations needed to keep the site lightweight and maintainable. If the MVP needs backend integration, I can handle that full stack as well.

I also understand that hosting on a cloud platform may require attention to deployment and server-side setup, so I can keep the implementation practical and ready for production use.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the Figma file, outlining the page structure, and then building the mobile experience first so you can validate the core MVP quickly.
